title: How should conversation and task state be stored?
description: Propose local SQLite-compatible storage supported by Mastra for conversation and runtime records. Plantool .plan remains the planning source of truth, not a runtime event database. Decide retention, backup/export, forget behavior and the boundary between global preferences and project knowledge before persistence implementation.
